title: Patch: the AI reads a Tradable card as dead when a maximum lowered for the rest of the game will never pay for it

**Issue #4812 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4812: Patch: the AI reads a Tradable card as dead when a maximum lowered for the rest of the game will never pay for it
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

`dead_in_hand` (R4154400) calls a Tradable card dead when its own cost is above the crystals the seat's next refresh brings, so the AI trades it away before its plays and holds it at a discount. `next_turn_crystals` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:1006-1014`) reads that refresh as "this turn's maximum, one more while it is under `MAX_MANA`":

```rust
let max = side.mana.max;
let grown = if max < MAX_MANA { max + CRYSTALS_PER_TURN } else { max };
```

After "lose N mana for the rest of the game" (`effects::change_max_mana` writes `mana.perm_mod`; S+ #95 JC Backed, and S+ #82 Endless Expedition through `lose_max_mana`), the maximum sits below `MAX_MANA` for good and never grows: the engine's `mana::max_mana_for` gives `min(turns, MAX_MANA) + perm_mod` at every refresh. `next_turn_crystals` still sees a maximum under `MAX_MANA` and answers one more.

Concrete: the AI at turn 9 with `mana.perm_mod = -1`, so its maximum is 3 at every refresh from now on. M #11 Double Header, a (4) Tradable card, is in its hand. `next_turn_crystals` answers 4, so the card is not dead: the AI keeps it at full price and never tries its Trade first, for the rest of the game.

### What should happen

R4154400: a card is "dead while it is Tradable now … and its own cost … is above the crystals its next refresh brings … So neither this turn's crystals nor the next turn's pay for it." The engine's next refresh brings 3.

The ruling's own formula sentence ("this turn's maximum, one more while under `MAX_MANA`, moved by the next-turn rider") is what the code implements, and it contradicts the ruling's conclusion in this case. The ruling needs amending in the same pull request.

### How to reproduce

Fails on `main` (3a83bd7): `a_tradable_card_is_dead_when_the_lowered_maximum_never_pays_for_it` in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_eval.rs` at bf24a52](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/bf24a52273bd5c0e7d6f9c740b28a8d7cb7f2b3e/crates/ai/tests/audit_eval.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`).

```rust
#[test]
fn a_tradable_card_is_dead_when_the_lowered_maximum_never_pays_for_it() {
    let mut state = board("audit-eval-dead",
        json!({ "hand": ["meditative-011", "core-008"], "mana": 0 }),
        json!({ "hand": ["core-008"], "field": ["core-008"] }));
    {
        // "Lose 1 mana for the rest of the game", as `effects::change_max_mana` writes it.
        let side = &mut state.players[AI];
        side.mana.perm_mod -= 1;
        side.mana.max = jackioh_engine::max_mana_for(side);
    }
    let card = state.players[AI].hand[0].clone();
    let cost = jackioh_engine::own_cost(&state, &card).expect("a cost");
    assert!(is_tradable(&state, &card));
    // What the engine's next refresh brings: the maximum once one more turn has started.
    let mut next = state.players[AI].clone();
    next.turns_started += 1;
    let brings = jackioh_engine::max_mana_for(&next);
    assert!(cost > state.players[AI].mana.max && cost > brings,
        "neither this turn's {} crystals nor the next refresh's {brings} pay for its ({cost})", state.players[AI].mana.max);
    assert!(dead_in_hand(&state, AI, &card),
        "R4154400: its cost ({cost}) is above the crystals its next refresh brings ({brings})");
}
```

(`board(seed, p1, p2)` registers the cards and builds a scenario with a four-card library each.) Output today: `R4154400: its cost (4) is above the crystals its next refresh brings (3)`. The flag is written by hand; a version that plays JC Backed through `reduce` would pin it on the shipped card.

### Where

The AI: `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` (`next_turn_crystals`, read by `dead_in_hand`).

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- Grow by one only while the capped base is under `MAX_MANA` (the maximum less `perm_mod` and less stolen crystals, all public counts), not while `mana.max` is. Better still, ask the engine: a read helper that answers what `max_mana_for` will give at the seat's next refresh, so the AI and the engine cannot drift apart again. The handicap stays unread (R180): that exclusion is deliberate and is not this.
- `perm_mod` is a public count, so reading it leaks nothing.
- By reading, not tested: with "lose all mana next N turns" pending, the next refresh brings 0 but the read says `max + 1`. It errs only toward "not dead"; decide whether the amended ruling covers it.
- The opposite error (a live card read as dead) would need stolen crystals above the cap before the cap is reached; not tested.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/tradable.rs`'s boards move the crystal count with the maximum and never meet `perm_mod`, so nothing pins the current reading. Only negative `perm_mod` cards exist in `crates/cards` today.

Found by an audit of the AI crate; the reproduction was run and the code path read before filing.

Helpers, copied exactly:

```rust
/// R4812000: `state` with the AI's crystal count the refreshes set the maximum from (R1854003) at `crystals`,
/// `perm_mod` on its maximum for the rest of the game, `stolen` crystals past the cap (R4331001) and Double
/// Header's cost moved by `cost_mod`, the maximum set as the engine sets it (`max_mana_for`).
fn lowered(state: &GameState, crystals: i32, perm_mod: i32, stolen: i32, cost_mod: i32) -> GameState {
    let mut state = state.clone();
    let side = &mut state.players[AI];
    side.turns_started += crystals - jackioh_engine::mana_crystal_count(side);
    side.mana.perm_mod = perm_mod;
    side.stolen_mana_crystals = Some(stolen).filter(|stolen| *stolen != 0);
    side.mana.max = jackioh_engine::max_mana_for(side);
    side.mana.current = side.mana.current.min(side.mana.max);
    side.hand
        .iter_mut()
        .find(|card| card.def_id == DOUBLE_HEADER)
        .expect("Double Header in the AI's hand")
        .cost_mod = cost_mod;
    state
}

/// What the engine's next refresh brings the AI of `state`: its maximum once one more turn has started.
fn next_refresh(state: &GameState) -> i32 {
    let mut next = state.players[AI].clone();
    next.turns_started += 1;
    jackioh_engine::max_mana_for(&next)
}
```
````

```rust
fn lowered(state: &GameState, crystals: i32, perm_mod: i32, stolen: i32, cost_mod: i32) -> GameState {
```
